verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no asynchronous batch-job submission API and no discounted batch pricing tier. The published price list shows a single per-input-token rate. The '12.2x cheaper' cookbook refers to packing many questions into one real-time call, and AsyncTypeSafeClient is an async request client, not a batch-job queue. Both are adjacent features that earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can submit asynchronous batch jobs at a documented discount versus real-time pricing
